title: Ulyana and the Kitchen
author: Rosalind Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Hartwell, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
